name: hovercard
title: HoverCard + HoverCardTrigger + HoverCardContent
description: Composable rich preview for supplementary information about a link or other focusable target. Use `HoverCard`, `HoverCardTrigger`, and `HoverCardContent`; use `asChild` when the trigger already supplies its own semantic element.

files.content: # Hover Card Composable rich preview for supplementary information about a link or other focusable target. Use `HoverCard`, `HoverCardTrigger`, and `HoverCardContent`; use `asChild` when the trigger already supplies its own semantic element. ```jsx @amara …profile summary… ``` Content must be supplementary, never the only way to reach information or an action. For plain text hints use Tooltip.
